units.source_text: 源氏对三人说：“帘内恐有知音人。

en.t: Genji said to the three of them, "There may be someone behind the blinds who understands music.
It would be best not to drink too much wine tonight.

units.source_text: 我这过了盛年的人，醉后容易感伤哭泣，

en.t: A man like me, past the prime of life, is easily moved to tears when drunk,

units.source_text: 生怕那时会把隐忍在心中的话说出口来。”

en.t: and I fear that then I might let slip the words I have kept hidden in my heart."
Tamakazura was very uneasy when she heard this.

units.source_text: 她对柏木和弁少将有不可断绝的兄弟之缘，

en.t: Her bond of kinship with Kashiwagi and Ben no Shosho could not be severed,
and it was quite unlike her ties with anyone else.

units.source_text: 因此她在帘内悄悄地偷看并窃听这两人的举动。

en.t: So from behind the blinds she secretly watched and listened to the movements of these two men.

units.source_text: 但对方做梦也不曾想到。

en.t: But they never imagined it, not even in their dreams.

units.source_text: 尤其是柏木，他正在倾心恋慕她，

en.t: Kashiwagi especially was deeply in love with her,

units.source_text: 今日逢此良机，胸中情思如火，不可遏制。

en.t: and now that he had met with such a fine opportunity, the feelings in his breast burned like fire and could not be restrained.

units.source_text: 但在人前硬装镇静模样，

en.t: Yet in front of others he forced himself to appear calm,
and for that reason he could not play the koto with an easy heart.
